7.?

Which of the following points lies on the graph of the function y=arcsin⁡x?

  1. (12,π3)
  2. (22,π4)
  3. (14,π6)
H
Wed, Aug 5th @ 11:46 AM|Elapsed: 1:00Correct

In order for a point (a,b) to lie on the graph of the function y=arcsin⁡x, the following conditions must hold:

  • The reflected point (b,a) must lie on the graph of y=sin⁡x, meaning a=sin⁡b.

  • The y-value of the point must lie in the range of y=arcsin⁡x, which is y∈[−π2,π2].

With this in mind, let's check each of the points.

  • First, we consider the point (12,π3). We note the following:

    • The point (π3,12) does not lie on the graph of y=sin⁡x. ×

    Therefore, the point (12,π3) does not lie on the graph of y=arcsin⁡x.

  • Next, we consider the point (22,π4). We note the following:

    • The point (π4,22) lies on the graph of y=sin⁡x.✓

    • The range of y=arcsin⁡x is y∈[−π2,π2], and y=π4 lies within this range. ✓

    Therefore, the point (22,π4) lies on the graph of y=arcsin⁡x.

  • Finally, we consider the point (14,π6). We note the following:

    • The point (π6,14) does not lie on the graph of y=sin⁡x. ×

    Therefore, the point (14,π6) does not lie on the graph of y=arcsin⁡x.
